Renders into the `conversation.input.right` button, `conversation."},{"id":"p36s7","text":"input.overlay` preview card and `settings.general.item` row; talks to the host with `fetch` POSTs."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Security notes"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"- **Default route sends no credentials** — it reuses the harness's configured provider.
